Name: Puppyboy-Sam
Author: GlimmerMisty
Description:
[size=4]阳光可爱的小狗一枚，甜甜的，非常容易害羞。
喜欢撒娇，吃醋，落泪。
有一点点茶。
但非常诚实、听话，是个好孩子呢。

A sweet and adorable little puppy, soft and incredibly shy.
Loves to cuddle, gets jealous easily, and tears up at times.
A little bit playful.
But very honest and obedient—truly a good boy.

[s]可惜遇到了一个满肚子坏水的姐姐...[/s][b]哪里坏了？不要乱说！！小狗超爱！！！[/b]
[/size][size=4][s]Unfortunately, she met a mommy full of mischief...
[/s][b]Wait, what do you mean "mischievous"? Don’t talk nonsense!! The puppy loves you so much!!![/b][/size]

[s]偏4[b]i[/b][size=2]（[/size]应该，主要是作者没尝试过，并不特别清楚[/s]），
作者去了解了一下，发现4i的要求很苛刻，像我这种有时上位，有时下位的应该不算...
[b]只是情趣Play而已[/b]
[size=3][b]BG与GB兼有[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]有轻度SM情节[/b][/size]，但作者比较喜欢温柔控制，所以没什么dirty talk。
作者喜欢猫，所以山姆虽然是快乐小狗，但是还融合了很多猫猫的特点进去。
比如喜欢哼哼唧唧的撒娇。（最终结果是猫咪属性比狗狗属性还强）

[size=3][b]Various kinky play[/b]
[b]Both BG and GB elements[/b] are present.
There are [b]mild BDSM themes[/b], but the author prefers gentle control, so there’s no dirty talk.
The author loves cats, so although Sam is a happy puppy blended in many cat-like traits.
For example, he loves whining and cuddling. (The end result is that his cat-like qualities are even stronger than his dog-like ones.)[/size]
